Designed with a rotary feature that flips 180° to evenly cook waffles inside and out, this kitchen essential bakes according to preference with a turn of the dial, from light to dark. Nonstick plates easily release a flawlessly formed Belgian waffle with deep pockets perfect for filling with fruit, meat, jams, whipped cream, and other toppings. A ready indicator light advises when the waffle is ready and prevents over- and under-cooking. Durable, brushed stainless steel housing complements any kitchen and wipes clean in seconds.

Featuring a seamlessly integrated kickstand, this case allows you to easily switch between landscape and portrait modes, perfect for hands-free photos, video calls, and entertainment. The featherlight composite construction strikes the perfect balance between sleek style and robust durability, ensuring your phone remains protected without added bulk. With sculpted corners, the Plasma XTE provides reinforced drop protection, while the raised screen surround offers extra protection against scratches and cracks. Equipped with a powerful built-in magnet module, this case is fully compatible with MagSafe charging, ensuring your device stays powered and ready. The Plasma XTE is the complete package for those seeking reliable protection and modern functionality.
